content.thinking: The deploy timestamp lines up exactly with the latency spike onset, while the logged errors are all account-page issues unrelated to latency, with no timeout messages appearing anywhere. That strongly points to the deployment itself as the cause, even though there's no explicit mention of a config change or feature flag behind it.
